detail: index.html was not authored and unclaimed-ep01.mp4 was not rendered. The timeline requires one clip plus one held still per beat from Loop C and Loop D, neither of which produced output. Composing 40 scenes over blank ground would produce a file of the right duration carrying none of the episode's visual content, so it was not produced.

audio_delivered.note: Full programme audio is complete and to spec: 40 measured narration takes on the 15 second grid, music bed ducked under the voice. It is the finished audio bed for the master and needs no rework when frames exist.
